title: Modern touring versus the old days
summary: With the interviewer he says modern air travel and chain hotels make every place alike, while the old bands stayed in each town's heart.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe

blocks.x: And you get to know the people and the whole atmosphere. Well, it's the same thing here in the United States. You can be in any city if you're staying in a Holiday Inn. You could be almost anyplace. Same thing.
Yeah, it's the same thing. That's what I was really talking about.
And when you used to travel around and, you know --
We always went into the heart of the city.
